A mailing list is a sub list of an address book, used to send mail to a group of contacts. Each contact must be in the same address book and have a valid email address.

An address book can have multiple mailing lists.

__TOC__

= Create a mailing list =
#Open the Address Book.
#In the left pane, to the right side of {button New Contact}, click the ''Create a new mailing list'' icon. See image below as a guide.
#;[[Image:New List icon]] 
#The 'New Mailing List' window opens. Enter all the Mailing List required details as indicated below.
#*'''Add to''': Click on the drop down icon and select Address book name
#*'''List Name''': Enter a suitable name for the mailing list.
#*'''List Nickname''': optional
#*'''Description''':optional, but useful to differentiate between multiple or similar Mailing Lists.
#;[[Image:New Mailing List]] 
== Adding contacts to a mailing list ==
There are  options to add contacts to the mailing list:<br><br>

=Alternative method to create a Mailing List=
#Open the Address Book.
#Select an address book name.
#Select to highlight contacts in the address book.
#*To select various contacts: Hold down the {for win,linux}{key Ctrl}{/for}{for mac}{key Command}{/for} key and left click the contacts.
#*To select a block: Select the first contact, hold down the {key Shift} key and select the last contact.
It will say X number of selected contacts and below offer some options:
# Click the {button New List} icon.
# A new Mailing List window opens with contacts already pre entered.
# Give Mailing List a suitable name and complete any other required fields.
# Click the {button OK} button.

= Edit a Mailing List =
There are two ways to edit a Mailing List, either via the ''Edit Mailing List'' name window or via the Mailing List display list.

== Add or remove a contact via the ''Edit Mailing List'' window ==
#Open the Address Book.
#Select the Mailing List name to highlight, click on the far right 3 dot menu icon and select {menu Edit List}.
#'''OR''' right click on a Mailing List name and select {menu Edit List}.

=== Add another contact ===
# Type one contact's email address per line.
# Click {button OK} when finished.

=== Remove a contact ===
# Highlight contact email address you wish to remove.
# Right click on highlighted email address and click {menu Delete}.
# Click {button OK} when finished.

== Add or remove a contact directly to the Mailing List display list ==
#Open the Address Book.

===Add a contact to a Mailing List===
#Select the address book name which contains the Mailing List.
#Left click and hold down on selected highlighted contact(s) to grab.
#Drag the contact(s) to the left and hover over the mailing list name.
#Release the mouse button to drop contact(s) into the mailing list.

===Remove a contact from Mailing List===
#Select the Mailing List name.
#Select the contact name in the Mailing List.
#Click the {button Edit} button shown in contact details.
#Click {button Delete}.
#Click {button Save}.

=Create a new Mailing List using a subset of contacts already in a Mailing List=
#Open the Address Book.
#Select the Mailing List name to see contacts.
#Select to highlight contacts in the Mailing List.
#*To select various contacts: Hold down the {for win,linux}{key Ctrl}{/for}{for mac}{key Command}{/for} key and left click the contacts.
#*To select a block: Select the first contact, hold down the {key Shift} key and select the last contact. 
# Below '''N selected contacts''', click {button New List}.
# A new Mailing List window opens with contacts already pre entered.
# Give the Mailing List a suitable name and complete any other required fields.
# Click the {button OK} button.
A new Mailing List is auto created with the subset of selected contacts.

= Create email using a mailing list =
There are two methods producing different results.

==Via the Address Book==
Useful if you need to select a subset or omit a contact or send list as individual named contacts.<br>
On the ''Spaces'' toolbar:
*Click the ''Address Book'' icon.
'''OR'''
On the ''Menu Bar'' toolbar:
*Click {menu Tools} and select {menu Address Book} to open.
#Select the mailing list to see contacts.
#Select to highlight contacts. 
#*To select various contacts: Hold down the {for win,linux}{key Ctrl}{/for}{for mac}{key Command}{/for} key and left click the contacts.
#*To select a block: Select the first contact, hold down the {key Shift} key and select the last contact.
#*To select all: Select the first contact and use {for win,linux}{key Ctrl}{/for}{for mac}{key Command}{/for}{key A}.
#You will see X number selected contacts. Click the {menu Write} button.
This will open a new Write compose message window, and each contact in the mailing list will appear in the ''To'' field. This allows you to remove a name, if desired.<br>
If required, you may need to manually select {button Bcc} to enable the ''Bcc'' field, then select all contacts and drag into the ''Bcc'' field - as your contacts may not want you to distribute their email address.<br>
Enter the Subject; Compose the email and click {button Send}.

=='''Via a new Write message'''==
On the ''Folder Pane Header'' Toolbar:
*Click the {menu + New Message} button.
A new Write message window will open, and on the left side there should be the 'Contacts Sidebar'.
*If you cannot see the Contacts Sidebar, you need to enable it.
**Click {menu View} > {menu Contacts Sidebar} or use the {key F9} key to toggle the view.
#Select the address book containing the mailing list.
#Use search to help locate Mailing List.
#Select the mailing list.
#Click the {button Add to Bcc} button or another option.
;[[Image:Mailing List Write]] 
This will add the mailing list name into the ''Bcc'' or ''Cc'' or ''To'' field. Note: it shows the Mailing List ''Description'' in brackets. 

You cannot see or alter the individual contacts of the mailing list in this format. But you can switch to individual names: Right click on the Mailing List name and select {menu Expand List}.

You can now complete the email with the subject and message content, then click {button Send}.
